name: Faiss Open-Source Local Vector Similarity Search
free_limit: MIT-licensed C++ library with Python bindings for local dense-vector similarity search and clustering; CPU indexes and optional GPU implementations have no vendor software subscription or per-query quota.
watch_out: Faiss is an embedded library, not a hosted vector database or free API. CPU/RAM/storage, optional GPU hardware and CUDA/ROCm dependencies, embedding generation and any cloud infrastructure are supplied separately and may cost money; follow MIT and third-party notices.
